final: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), shares AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
